description: Spec 010 Gate 5 plan (draft until the decision record experiments/<date>-g5-decision/ binds it; never edited after). The carried Gate 2 E (e-s3) frozen, points unchanged; its course stated in the truncated form (research R2: arc +/-X at most 45 degrees, P exactly the arc mass, a von Mises shape inside), P a logistic function of causal features (E's log sds, the recent-bearing-residual proxy and C's open flag, the minute; R1, R3) with a Platt map fitted on validation tuning ordinals 0-499; range and speed 95% intervals. Controls registered here (R6): the sd^beta temperature per cell (tuning rows), the classical rule (quadratics in the three log sds plus linear proxy terms, fitted on the training stream), and the encoder-only shuffled head (best and last epoch). The head is the classical rule plus a bounded residual on E-w's encoder state, the sds, C's code and the proxy design; three seeds.
